svg.title: Training a large language model
svg.desc: Seven training stages, four resource categories, and reported Llama and DeepSeek examples. Full accessible text and source links accompany this graphic.
svg.text: How data becomes a deployed system, and where resources go
Rahul Niroop November 8, 2026 Published examples from 2023-2025
Gather text and code with documented rights and provenance.
Coverage and licensing shape quality, risk, and acquisition cost.
Clean text, protect privacy, split test data, and create tokens.
Tokens are text pieces. Keep evaluation examples out of training.
Choose model size and architecture. Pilot small runs before scaling.
Fit useful model capacity and training data to a compute budget.
Predict tokens, measure error, and update the learned model weights.
Gradients guide updates. Many GPUs repeat this across batches.
Teach instructions with examples, then refine responses with feedback.
Human ratings and checked synthetic examples guide model behavior.
Test task accuracy, factuality, bias, privacy, and misuse resistance.
Use separate tests. Failed checks can send work back to earlier stages.
Optimize and serve the model. Monitor response speed and reliability.
Generation uses ongoing compute. Ordinary prompts do not update weights.

networks share work. Memory holds weights

Letter badges link stages to typical resource emphasis, not exclusive use or measured budget shares.
Evaluation can return work to data preparation or model design. Skilled people support every stage. [1-3, 6, 8]
GPU-hours shown on a common scale (millions). Hardware and scope differ.

04 READ THE UNITS BEFORE THE PRICE TAG
Time is not the same as GPU-hours
Calculated at full occupancy. The report says less than two months. Research and
Capacity-based proxy, not metered electricity. Cooling and other equipment depend
B = billion parameters. T = trillion tokens in model data labels. A GPU-hour = one GPU for one hour.
GPU = graphics processing unit. TPU = tensor processing unit. D, C, E, T badges use the resource key above.
